status: frozen curation plan before extended review and any CAD model output
train_selection: Within each original E/N/C class, first 128 of the 1614 common structural candidates sorted by sha256(UTF-8(seed+family_id)), then family_id; 384 total, no replacement
dev_selection: All 199 common structurally qualified author dev families; no replacement
previous_exposure: The earlier fixed 24 train/6 dev semantic sample is included. Its source-quality findings motivated this curation; no model results exist. Do not call all 583 families unread at freeze.
label_contract: Author E maps positive, N/C map negative. Preserve original strings and all three-class labels; only eligibility changes.
acceptance: All five complete P/H views support their published binary labels under ordinary literal NLI. RP must keep H and materially change P; RH must keep P and materially change H. Every view is read before family decision.
allowed_inference: Ordinary lexical entailment, unambiguous reference, and direct compositional implications. Do not invent exotic possible worlds to reject ordinary text.
disallowed_inference: Do not add an unmentioned entity, cause, purpose, destination, device, temporal overlap, exact amount, or scope to make a positive label true.
negative_contract: Only absence of entailment is required. Dispute between neutral and contradiction alone is not a binary failure.
uncertainty: Ambiguous identity, grammar, referent or necessary relation: mark ambiguous and do not adopt the whole family. No relabeling or repair.
exclusion: One unsupported/ambiguous view or non-substantive edit excludes the entire family from every training arm and shared dev pool. Keep all records/reasons; never replace excluded families.
reviewers: Research agents, not human or medical-expert reannotation. This is an agent-reviewed nonmedical auxiliary subset, not a clean-gold claim or a full CAD replication.
review_records: For each family: every view's supported/unsupported/ambiguous status and short reason, material edit checks, final eligible boolean with reason. Five views must be complete, even when early failure is found.
shards: Sort selected family IDs and assign round-robin to three reviewers; no overlapping primary ownership. Root validates full coverage and exclusion consistency before data freeze.
weight_update: After curation, recompute original-class family counts and S=4435+retained_train_families under the same class/domain weighting design. No head is fitted until shared membership and training plan are frozen.
